Plot bootstrap distributions

Source: R/plots.R
plot.litfit_bootstrap.Rd

Plots the density of the bootstrap distribution of one or more parameters (or derived quantities) from bootstrap_parameters.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'litfit_bootstrap'
plot(x, coef.index = 1, bw = "nrd0", conf.level = 0.95, ...)

Arguments

x

a litfit_bootstrap object

coef.index

which column(s) to plot: a number, a column name such as "k" or "steady_state", a vector of either, or "all". Several columns are drawn in a grid of panels. With "all", columns without at least two finite values (e.g. an always-infinite steady state) are skipped with a warning.

bw

bandwidth (or bandwidth rule, see density) for the density

conf.level

width of the shaded central interval (default 0.95)

...

additional arguments passed to plot.default

Value

x, invisibly

Details

The grey fill covers the central conf.level interval of the distribution. The red dashed line shows the mean and the blue dashed line the median. Non-finite values (e.g. an infinite steady state) and failed replicates are ignored.

See also

bootstrap_parameters, density

Author

James Weedon

Examples

fit <- fit_litter(
  time = pineneedles$Year, mass.remaining = pineneedles$Mass.remaining,
  model = "weibull", iters = 100, quiet = TRUE
)
boot <- bootstrap_parameters(fit, nboot = 200)
#> Warning: 1 of 200 bootstrap replicates failed and are recorded as NA
plot(boot)
plot(boot, coef.index = "all")
